summary:
# Watch your own IPTV content on Meta Quest

OnlyIPTV is a free, VR-friendly IPTV player designed for Meta Quest. It allows you to add and watch your own IPTV content through M3U playlists, with a clean interface built for comfortable live TV viewing in virtual reality.

# A simple IPTV media player for VR

With OnlyIPTV, you can browse your live TV channels, organize your playlists, and enjoy a simple media player experience directly on your Quest headset.
